files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: For riders without a birth_year, use the most common birth year among riders of the same home district (trim spaces and use title case for the district); if several years are equally common, take the earliest. `result` should be a table with the columns rider_id, home_district and birth_year.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv, normalise home_district (strip, title case); for each district find the most frequent non-empty birth_year (smallest year among ties); replace each empty birth_year by its district's value; return rider_id, home_district (normalised) and birth_year for every rider.

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros; home_district may be the original text; birth_year may be float

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
